record.question: C. Lalnunchaga has written a fantasy novel called
record.explanation: The MAL bibliography identifies Kawlkil Piah Lamtluang as C. Lalnunchanga’s fantasy novel and 2015 award winner. The other choices are attributed to different writers. Reference: https://dcserchhip.mizoram.gov.in/page/mizo-academy-of-letters-book-of-the-year-list; https://in.boell.org/sites/default/files/after_decades_of_silence_voices_from_mizoram.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
